title: Training Institute Franchise Opportunity
name: Boston Institute Of Analytics, 107 Franchisees, Est'd in 2019, Boston HQ
description: Education and professional upskilling business offering a franchise opportunity focused on job-oriented training and career development. - Caters to students, working professionals, and career switchers aged 18–45 seeking industry-relevant skills, career advancement, or entry into new professional fields. - Offers a diverse portfolio of specialized courses across technology, finance, creative industries, and business communications. - Training is delivered through structured curricula supported by a learning management system (LMS), providing a consistent learning framework across franchise locations. - The education model includes guaranteed internships, placement support after course completion, and globally recognized certificates to enhance learners' employability and career prospects. - Offers a franchise model with an investment requirement of approximately ₹15–25 lakh and a five-year franchise agreement. - Franchise partners receive ongoing training, operational systems, and marketing guidance from the franchisor to support business development and day-to-day operations. - The business targets the growing demand for specialized skills, professional certifications, and employment-oriented education. - Holds a Certificate of Incorporation and offers franchise partners an opportunity to establish a structured education and career-development business. - The management team associated with this opportunity is based in India.
